newsitem.title: USA: Sequent files for 5.25 mln share offering.
newsitem.headline: Sequent files for 5.25 mln share offering.

text.p: Sequent Computer Systems Inc said it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 5,250,000 shares of common stock.

Of the total number of shares, 4,199,439 would be sold by the company and 1,050,561 by selling shareholders. Of the 5,250,000 shares of Common Stock being offered, 4,200,000 shares are being initially offered in the United States and Canada and 1,050,000 shares are being initially offered outside the United States and Canada.

Sequent said the managing underwriters for the offering, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Cowen & Co and SoundView Financial Group Inc will receive options to buy up to 787,500 additional shares to cover overallotments, if any.
